verdict.rationale: USCIS's own site lists "Check processing times" among its online case-management tools, so the service does publish processing times itself. The evidence is a single link-label mention with no detail on per-form or per-office granularity, update cadence, or how current the figures are. Missing for 10: documentation that times are broken down by transaction/form type, evidence of freshness or update frequency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the tool.
